headline: 15.6 billion dinars in liquidity on Kuwait Stock Exchange in 9 months
summary: Kuwait Stock Exchange trading data for the first nine months of 2026 show liquidity of 15.6 billion dinars. Activity continued despite geopolitical and economic developments in the region.
why: The Kuwait Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and trading liquidity indicates investor participation.
